request: 撤下LFS巨包，本地完整镜像优先、缺少镜像先编译、失败从官方Release校验回退，发布新版本
acceptance: Current tree contains no runtime LFS bundle or LFS attributes; ordinary clone has no required LFS fetch.

POSIX and Windows ordinary startup reuse validated native complete local runtime; source/force bypass normal reuse. Missing runtime builds locally, then falls back to verified official Release after failure; strict flag returns failure.
Corrupt cache, wrong architecture, failed import or missing official manifest stay fatal; user data and production service remain intact.
Focused startup tests, current quick/full checks and isolated release runtime smoke have real evidence. Native Windows not claimed.
Bump existing daily version on clean main and publish a new GitHub Release with exact-source runtime assets, checksums and limitations.

requirements.summary: Local installed runtime first, source compile when absent, verified Release fallback on failure. Remove current LFS distribution and publish daily version.

design.summary: Reuse existing identity/SHA256 importer and local dependency recovery; add explicit fallback disable flag, preserve force and separate offline launchers.

implementation.summary: POSIX and PowerShell paths updated; current LFS bundle, attributes and builder withdrawn. Source archive checkout supported without Git metadata.

verification.summary: 130 full-profile checks passed, including 1022 registered server items in 12 serial shards. Original full command exited 1 only for Docker external-bind CAD transport; unchanged CAD assertions passed with SHA256-identical internal fixture mounts. Receipt preserves original failure and retry lineage. 38 launcher tests and real pinned Release recovery passed. Native Windows and host TLS API probe not claimed.

documentation.summary: Current startup priority, force/strict switches, LFS withdrawal, source vs fallback version and release notes are documented with actual limits.

cleanup.summary: Removed current tracked LFS bundle and 1725320689-byte local LFS cache; retired own LFS filters/hooks. Isolated QA stopped through original stop command; exact containers, network and test image alias removed. Production untouched.

release_authorization: User directly requested removing the huge LFS image, local-first compile with official Release fallback, and Release a new version. Existing main push authorization applies; no production replacement authorized.
rollback: Revert scoped startup changes; retain current production images and user data. Do not restore huge LFS artifact or force-rewrite remote history.
